name: zeltjs
description: Portable application framework with DI — Node, Workers, Lambda... anywhere.

scripts.check:no-neverthrow-leak: grep -r 'neverthrow' packages/*/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null && echo 'WARN: neverthrow leaked to public API' || true
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:packages && eslint . --ignore-pattern 'packages/**' --ignore-pattern 'examples/**' && oxlint . && pnpm lint:core-layers
scripts.test:runtime-contracts: node --test scripts/verify-workspace-cli-bins.test.mjs scripts/verify-decorator-positions.test.mjs scripts/verify-dist-runtime-contracts.test.mjs scripts/verify-dist-tree-shaking.test.mjs scripts/pure-class-decorators.test.mjs scripts/verify-portable-context.test.mjs scripts/resolve-txiki-runtime.test.mjs scripts/prepare-integration-deps.test.mjs scripts/typecheck-project.test.mjs scripts/distribution-cache.test.mjs scripts/verify-inspection-entries.test.mjs
scripts.precommit: pnpm nx run @zeltjs/eslint-plugin:build && ./scripts/format-staged.sh && pnpx lint-staged && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:cycle && pnpm build && pnpm test:runtime-contracts && pnpm verify-dist:runtime-contracts && pnpm lint && pnpm --filter '@examples/*' typecheck && pnpm verify-generated:openapi && pnpm verify-generated:studio-snapshot && pnpm --filter website verify:docs && pnpm verify-dist && pnpm verify-dist:tree-shaking && pnpm check:no-neverthrow-leak && pnpm throw-trace && pnpm test && npx precommit-verify save
